nodes.plm_action: mix the raw materials
nodes.plm_caption:
This video shows a young boy drawing on a wall. There is also a woman that is adding some cleaning ingredients into a bowl. The woman then cleans the wall with a toothbrush. There is a background music that is playing as well.
The boy is wearing a red shirt and is standing in front of a white wall that has scribbles on it. He has a piece of white chalk in his right hand and is drawing on the wall. The wall and the chalk are mostly blue. The boy has brown hair and is standing with his body facing slightly to the left, so only the right side of his body can be seen.
A woman is holding the bowl with the left hand, while using the right hand to squeeze toothpaste into it. She then squeezes the bottle of shampoo into the bowl and stirs the ingredients together with a toothbrush. Then, she moves closer to the wall, and cleans it with the toothbrush. The wall is clean.
The music background has many colors, with lots of pink and yellow lights. It's very bright and there are three small white "v" lines that are playing in the music.

summary.brief: A child draws on a wall and a woman cleans the marks away with a toothpaste‑shampoo mixture.
summary.detailed: The video begins with a young boy wearing a red shirt who draws blue‑tinted chalk designs on a white wall while upbeat background music plays. After the drawing segment, a woman appears, holding a white bowl in her left hand. She squeezes toothpaste and yellow shampoo into the bowl, stirs the mixture with a white toothbrush, then moves toward the wall and repeatedly scrubs the pencil and crayon marks with the toothbrush, gradually erasing them until the wall is clean. The clip ends with a black screen that displays “Thanks for watching.”

action.detailed: Mix toothpaste and shampoo in a bowl, stir the paste with a toothbrush, then scrub the wall with the toothbrush to remove the markings.

nodes.plm_action: Add a small amount of toothpaste to a bowl
nodes.plm_caption: This video features shots of a child drawing pictures on a wall as text "Ash Corner by PowerDirector" plays. The video then cuts to someone pouring toothpaste into a bowl, along with orange-colored liquid. The person then stirs the two liquids together with a toothbrush, which rotates in a clockwise direction as they do so.

summary.brief: Children draw on a board, then a person mixes toothpaste, shampoo and other cleaning items in a bowl while stirring with a toothbrush.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a bright white title screen that reads “Ash Corner by PowerDirector” and shows a laptop, a phone and a small plant. It then cuts to a young child using a crayon or marker to make colorful scribbles on a white board, with a red SUBSCRIBE button and a PowerDirector watermark visible. A quick montage shows several children adding details to drawings on a wall. After the montage, the view shifts to a close‑up of a dark‑complexioned hand on a tiled floor. The hand unscrews a red‑white toothpaste tube, squeezes the paste straight into a small white bowl, and then tilts a yellow shampoo bottle to pour its contents into the same bowl, creating an orange‑yellow mixture. Additional ingredients such as baking soda are added, and the person stirs the blend with a white toothbrush, rotating the brush clockwise until a uniform paste forms. Towards the end, oil and water are poured into a plastic cup and mixed in a circular motion, all while background music plays.

action.detailed: Squeeze toothpaste into a white bowl, add shampoo (and other ingredients), then rotate a toothbrush clockwise to stir the blend into a smooth cleaning paste.
action.actor: a person with a dark‑complexioned hand

nodes.plm_action: apply cleaning agen
nodes.plm_caption: A person is holding a white bowl and holds it in their left hand as they rub a white toothbrush onto the wall with their right hand. Then they use the toothbrush to rub against the wall over and over and clean the marks on the wall. The video ends with a black screen that reads 'thanks for watching' in large letters. The video appears to be demonstrating how to clean a wall with a brush and cleaning solution. The person is making a tutorial on how to clean a wall with a brush. There are pencil marks on the wall before the person. The person also points at the marks on the wall with their index finger at one point during the video. A white wall is visible in the background. The wall is white in color. It has pencil marks all over it. The pencil marks are black. The person is holding the bowl and toothbrush in the left hand. The person is wearing a ring on their index finger. The person uses their right hand to rub the brush on the wall. The person's hand is visible throughout the video. There is a window in the background of the shot at some point during the video. Light is reflecting on the wall in the background. A mobile phone is visible in the video. The mobile phone is gold in color. There is a colorful background in the shot during the video. A logo in white and black is visible in the video. A white bowl is visible in the video. The bowl is located in the middle of the shot. A white toothbrush is visible in the video. The toothbrush is located in the person's right hand.

summary.brief: A person cleans pencil marks from a white wall using a toothbrush dipped in a yellow‑white cleaning paste, then finishes with a brief ash‑sprinkle clip and a thank‑you end screen.
summary.detailed: The demonstrator holds a white bowl filled with a yellow‑white cleaning paste in the left hand while a white toothbrush rests in the right hand. After pointing at the black and blue pencil marks on the white wall, they dip the brush in the paste and scrub the wall with repeated strokes, occasionally rinsing and re‑dipping the brush as the marks fade. Light from a nearby window reflects on the wall, and a gold‑colored phone and a small logo are visible in the background. Near the end of the cleaning segment a short clip shows ash‑like particles being sprinkled onto the wall while the “Ash Corner” watermark appears. The video concludes with a black screen that displays the words “Thanks for Watching” in large white letters.

action.detailed: Hold the bowl of cleaning paste in the left hand, dip the toothbrush into the paste, and scrub the pencil marks on the wall with repeated strokes, rinsing and re‑dipping the brush as needed until the marks are removed.

nodes.plm_action: draw black patterns
nodes.plm_caption: Children are drawing on walls. A YouTube subscribe button appears near the end of each video segment.

summary.brief: A title card appears, then a fast‑paced montage shows children drawing colorful sketches on a white surface while red “SUBSCRIBE” graphics and a PowerDirector watermark overlay the shots, ending with a static view of a white bowl.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a bright title screen that reads “Ash Corner by PowerDirector” against a plain white background and displays a laptop, a smartphone, a small plant and, in the foreground, a child holding a marker. It then cuts to a series of still frames that each show a child (or children) drawing on a whiteboard or wall with markers or crayons. The images include random scribbles, a unicorn on a hill, a beach scene with a pink‑clad girl, a stick‑figure with a green line added underneath, and other simple shapes rendered in red, green, blue and black. Every frame is overlaid with a red “SUBSCRIBE” button in the lower‑left corner and a “by PowerDirector” watermark in the lower‑right. The montage continues with close‑up shots of the drawing hand adding detail, and finishes with a static shot of a white ceramic bowl on a white floor, its shadow moving across the surface. Bright, sunny lighting is maintained throughout.

action.detailed: Hold a marker or crayon and move it across the white board or wall, creating scribbles and adding details such as a green line under a stick figure, while the hand repeatedly strokes the surface.

nodes.plm_action: adding toothpaste
nodes.plm_caption:
This video shows a person adding various substances to a bowl and mixing them together. The bowl is white, and the floor is a tile floor. The person's hand is a dark-complexioned hand.
The person in this video appears to be making something on this table.
The person adds toothpaste, and a bottle of shampoo. The toothpaste is already used, as there is a brown stain on it, and so is the shampoo, which is yellow in color. The toothpaste is poured straight down into the bowl, and the shampoo is poured at an angle.

The person is adding the toothpaste to the bowl, so that it can be washed away in the water, and can clean off the dust stains. The person adds the shampoo to the bowl and adds it with the toothpaste and stirs it around, as the substance is yellow in color.

summary.brief: A hand opens a toothpaste tube, squeezes the paste into a white bowl on a tiled floor, adds shampoo and other liquids, and mixes everything with a toothbrush.
summary.detailed: The clip begins with a close‑up of a dark‑complexioned hand opening the red‑capped toothpaste tube and squeezing a dollop of toothpaste into a small white bowl that sits on a white‑tile surface; the hand lifts the bowl briefly, then brings a yellow shampoo bottle, removes its cap and pours the shampoo into the same bowl, followed by a small amount of oil (or water) and a pinch of baking‑soda that were already present; finally, the hand picks up a white toothbrush and rotates it, stirring the combined ingredients until the mixture appears uniformly blended, all lit by bright, natural lighting with a faint watermark in the corner.

action.detailed: Squeeze toothpaste into the bowl, add shampoo (and a bit of oil or water plus baking‑soda), and stir the mixture with a toothbrush until it is evenly blended.

nodes.plm_action: Wipe marks away with a cloth or paper towel
nodes.plm_caption: A person is using a white bowl of a yellow and white paste, and a toothbrush, to clean some scribbles on a white wall. They pour the paste onto the toothbrush and run it over the wall in multiple strokes repeatedly. The white bowl with the paste is on a marbled counter, and the wall has a little bit of blue scribbles on it. The scene is brightly lit.

summary.brief: A person brushes a yellow‑white paste from a bowl onto a toothbrush and scrubs blue scribbles off a white wall.
summary.detailed: The video shows a person standing before a white wall that is covered with blue and black scribbles. On a white marble countertop a white bowl holds a yellow‑white paste made by mixing a powder with water. The person holds the bowl in the left hand, dips a white toothbrush with blue bristles into the paste, and applies it to the scribbles, brushing back and forth across the wall. The brush is repeatedly re‑dipped and the paste is sprinkled onto the wall in small spots as needed. Under bright illumination, the repeated strokes gradually remove the marks, leaving the wall mostly clean.

action.detailed: Mix the powder with water in the bowl, dip the toothbrush, and scrub the scribbled wall repeatedly, re‑dipping as needed to remove the marks.
action.actor: A person holding the bowl in the left hand and a toothbrush in the right hand

nodes.plm_action: Use the brush on the glass to color it in
nodes.plm_caption: The video starts with a very blurry and unfocused image of what seems to be an uncut piece of paper or board. Below that there are various colors and shapes displayed on what looks to be the screen of a phone which are being zoomed in slowly and shown more clearly. Some of the images or designs are moving and making an appearance of waves and some appear to be making a clinking sound. The screen then cuts away and the words "Thanks for Watching" appear and display in all caps. There is some sort of design that goes under the words, and then it cuts and disappears to blackness. The video is uncut.

summary.brief: The clip shows a blurred background, a phone screen with a YouTube subscription notice, and a “Thanks for Watching” end‑screen that fades to black.
summary.detailed: The final segment opens with an out‑of‑focus view that looks like a piece of paper or board while a smartphone screen behind it displays colorful shapes that slowly become clearer as the view zooms in. The phone shows a YouTube interface with the channel title “Ash Corner”, a bell icon and other YouTube controls, and an overlay notification indicating a subscription (a bell, the word “SUBSCRIBED”, the number “150” and additional icons). The video then switches to a stylized closing slide where large white text reads “THANKS FOR WATCHING” on a dark background adorned with wavy lines, sparkly dots and a small “by PowerDirector” label. The segment ends with a plain black screen.

action.detailed: Show a subscription notification on the phone, transition to a “Thanks for Watching” graphic with animated lines and dots, and then fade to a black screen.

nodes.plm_action: draw black figures
nodes.plm_caption: A young girl uses a black crayon to scribble random things onto a white board. Her name is "ash". In the beginning, we see a computer desk with a white background. The words "ash corner" appear prominently. We then see the beginning of "ash's" drawing.

summary.brief: A minimalist desk scene shows the title “Ash Corner” with a laptop, phone and plant, then a young girl named Ash draws on a white board with a black crayon.
summary.detailed: The video opens to a bright white background where the bold cursive title “Ash Corner” is centered, accompanied by a laptop in the top‑left, a smartphone in the top‑right, and a small plant near the bottom. The camera then shifts to reveal a young girl, identified as Ash, holding a black crayon and creating random scribbles on a nearby white board.

action.detailed: Scribble random marks on the white board using a black crayon.

nodes.plm_action: Draw
nodes.plm_caption: An ad for a channel called "Cyberlink" featuring kids drawing on walls. It cuts between still shots of drawings and the channel logo in the bottom left corner and also "PowerDirector" in the bottom right corner. The first still shows a young girl making scribbles on a wall with a green marker. The second still shows a picture of the channel logo and name on a wall. The third still shows a young boy adding details to a drawing on a wall. The fourth still shows a crumpled and scrunched drawing on a wall. The fifth still shows a white ceramic bowl on a white floor. The video ends with a final cut to the channel logo and the name. It is all on a white background with a red and white logo.

summary.brief: A quick montage of children drawing colorful scribbles on whiteboards and walls, each frame overlaid with a red Subscribe button and PowerDirector branding, ending with a static screen showing a white bowl.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a child standing in front of a white dry‑erase board, holding a marker in the right hand and making bright scribbles while a red Subscribe button appears in the lower‑left corner and a PowerDirector watermark sits in the lower‑right. It then shows a white sheet completely covered in multicolored crayon marks, again with the same Subscribe overlay. The next shots present still images of children’s artwork – a unicorn on a hill and a beach scene with a pink‑clad girl – each framed by the Subscribe button and PowerDirector logo. After that a boy wearing a red shirt is seen drawing a simple stick‑figure on a white wall with a green crayon, adding a green line beneath the figure and later outlining a head with a black marker. The montage briefly zooms in on close‑up scribbles before cutting to a final static end‑screen that displays a white ceramic bowl on a white floor, accompanied by the channel logo in the bottom left and the PowerDirector watermark in the bottom right.

action.detailed: The child holds a marker or crayon and applies strokes to the white surface, sketching a figure, adding a green underline and other simple details.
action.actor: A young child, a boy wearing a red shirt

nodes.plm_action: add toothpaste
nodes.plm_caption:
The video shows someone squeezing toothpaste into a bowl on the floor. The person opens the red lid of the tube. They then hold the bowl up and put toothpaste in the center of the bowl. After a moment they put the bowl down again.
The video has a watermark on the lower right which reads "CyberLink by PowerDirector. ".

summary.brief: Toothpaste is squeezed into a bowl, which is briefly lifted, then a white liquid is added and the mixture is gently shaken.
summary.detailed: A hand removes the red cap from a toothpaste tube, squeezes a small amount of paste into the centre of a white bowl that sits on a white‑tiled floor, lifts the bowl for a moment to show the paste inside, and sets it back down. A white bottle is then tipped, pouring a creamy white‑yellow liquid into the same bowl, creating a combined paste that is lightly agitated before the bowl is returned to the surface. The lower‑right corner of the frame shows a “CyberLink by PowerDirector” watermark.

action.brief: Add toothpaste and liquid to bowl
action.detailed: Remove the cap from the toothpaste tube, squeeze paste into the bowl, briefly lift the bowl, tip a bottle of white liquid into the bowl, and gently shake or stir the mixture before placing the bowl back down.

nodes.plm_action: pour some glue to the fac
nodes.plm_caption:
The video shows a person mixing ingredients together in a small bowl. At the beginning of the video, they have a bowl with a thick white and orange substance inside, while they have a bottle that is opened and the cap off as well and it is orange and yellow in color. They put some of the mixture in the white bowl, and there is a toothbrush which they are using to put on a toothpaste and mix the content together. At the end, the person uses their hand to hold the bowl and put down the toothbrush. The video is quite dark as well, so you are able to see the items in the bowl, but others are a bit dark.
The lighting is quite dim, where the video doesn't have a lot of contrast. The video has been seen through a mobile, so there is a shadow of the phone over the video as well. The background is quite dark as well. The video has quite some text on it too, and it is written in English.
At the beginning of the video, they have an item in the corner, and it says " Ash Comer". At the end of the video as well, there is another text that is on the right corner, and it says "Cyberlink by PowerDirector".
There is quite some shadowing, especially from the mobile phone on the video itself. The item in the corner also casts a shadow on the video. There is also some shadowing at the bottom from the white background itself.

summary.brief: A hand adds shampoo to a paste in a bowl and stirs it with a toothbrush.
summary.detailed: The clip opens on a small white bowl that already holds a thick white‑orange paste. A hand lifts the bowl, adds a small dollop of additional white paste from a container, then shows an orange‑yellow shampoo bottle, removes its cap and pours the shampoo into the same bowl. The hand continuously rotates the bowl while using a toothbrush to stir and blend the ingredients together until a uniform mixture is formed. The scene is dimly lit, overlaid with the on‑screen watermarks “Ash Corner” and “by PowerDirector,” and ends with the hand setting the toothbrush down beside the bowl.

action.detailed: Add the paste and shampoo into the bowl and stir the mixture thoroughly with a toothbrush, rotating the bowl as needed to blend the ingredients.

nodes.plm_action: Apply toothpaste directly on wall and rub all over
nodes.plm_caption:
A person is mixing a mixture of baking soda and water, then sprinkling it on some scribbles on a wall and scrubbing them with a toothbrush. The wall is white and the scribbles are blue. There are other black marks on the wall. The toothbrush is white with blue bristles.
The person uses their right hand to hold the white bowl and moves the hand in an anticlockwise motion to mix the powder and liquid. The person then uses their hand to sprinkle the powder in small dots all over the scribbles on the wall. They use the toothbrush to scrub the scribbles, moving in random motions all over the scribbles. At the end they hold the toothbrush vertically with the bristles pointing outwards.

summary.brief: A hand mixes a powder‑water paste, spreads it on a scribbled wall and scrubs the marks away with a toothbrush.
summary.detailed: The demonstrator holds a white bowl in one hand and stirs a white powder with water, rotating the bowl anticlockwise until a paste forms. The hand then sprinkles the paste in small dots over blue and black scribbles on a white wall. A toothbrush is repeatedly dipped into the bowl, lifted, and used to scrub the pasted area in varied back‑and‑forth and circular strokes, re‑dipping as needed. The strokes continue until most of the marks are removed, and the clip ends with the toothbrush held vertically, bristles pointing outward.

action.detailed: Mix the powder with water in the bowl, sprinkle the resulting paste onto the scribbles, dip the toothbrush into the paste and scrub the wall until the marks are removed.
action.actor: the demonstrator’s hand (holding the bowl in one hand and the toothbrush in the other)

nodes.plm_action: Apply joint compound to hole
nodes.plm_caption: This is a video of someone or something sprinkling ash or glitter onto a wall.

summary.brief: Black ash‑like dots appear on a white wall with blue “Ash Comer” text overlay and a “Cyberlink by PowerDirector” watermark.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a white screen showing blue “Ash Comer” text in the upper left and a “Cyberlink by PowerDirector” watermark in the lower right while a blurry, dirt‑like smudge containing a few black specks drifts across the centre. The view then shifts to a plain white wall where small black stains resembling ash become visible; bright lighting creates a shadow on the right side of the wall. A circular cluster of black dots then forms in the centre of the wall and shifts slightly, giving the impression that ash or glitter is being sprinkled onto the surface, all while the overlay text remains static.

action.detailed: Sprinkle ash onto the wall so that black specks appear and spread across the surface, forming a faint circular pattern.

nodes.plm_action: Show the winner of the challenge
nodes.plm_caption: This video features an animated shot of a smartphone. The smartphone has a pink and beige screen displaying a video with the caption "Ash Corner" in the top left corner. There is a large bell icon in the top left corner of the video screen. In the bottom of the video are four small icons, and a caption that displays a phone number. The video has a blurred background in a range of colors.

summary.brief: A smartphone screen shows a YouTube video titled “Ash Corner” with a bell icon, bottom icons and a phone‑number caption against a blurred pastel background.
summary.detailed: The clip displays an animated view of a handheld smartphone held in portrait orientation. On the phone’s screen the YouTube app is visible, showing the video title “Ash Corner” in the upper‑left corner, a large bell icon, and four small icons along the bottom. Beneath the video a caption containing a phone number is displayed. The surrounding backdrop is softly blurred with pink, beige and other pastel lights, giving a dreamy, out‑of‑focus effect.

action.detailed: Display the YouTube interface on the phone, showing the title “Ash Corner”, a bell icon, bottom icons, and a phone‑number caption while the blurred pastel background stays static.

The background is a blurred pink and orange color.

The screen says "thanks for watching". A black screen is the background of the last part of the video.

summary.brief: The video ends with a phone subscription notification followed by a black “Thanks for Watching” slide.
